name: 611. A Vertex batch's reserved labels are the gateway's on native lines too (vertex batch reserved labels)
description: TXE-6974: results read a Vertex Gemini batch line's url and custom_id back from the request labels bifrost_endpoint and bifrost_custom_id / bifrost_custom_id_b32_<n>. A native line (contents, no messages or prompt) kept its own labels as sent, so a caller could mark a text line as an image generation (settled at image rates, or parked unpriced) or give a line another custom_id. The gateway now removes every reserved label from every line before writing its own. Both rows run on the Vertex endpoint fixture (vertex-endpoint-fixture.mjs, vertexEndpointFixture=1), which keeps the uploaded JSONL and writes predictions that echo each line's labels: row 1 reads the labels the gateway sent, row 2 reads the results back. They are skipped without the fixture.

item.name: 611.1 vertex vertex batch reserved labels: a native line's own bifrost_endpoint and bifrost_custom_id labels are not uploaded

exec: pm.test('the batch is created on the fixture', function () { pm.expect(j.id, pm.response.text().slice(0, 400)).to.match(/batchPredictionJobs\/\d+$/); });
pm.test('two lines were uploaded', function () { pm.expect(labels.length, input.body.slice(0, 400)).to.equal(2); });

pm.test('a native line with a custom_id carries the caller\'s own label and the gateway\'s custom_id only', function () { pm.expect(labels[0], JSON.stringify(labels[0])).to.eql({ team: 'tokun', bifrost_custom_id: 'native-1' }); });
pm.test('a native line with no custom_id carries none of the caller\'s reserved labels', function () { pm.expect(labels[1], JSON.stringify(labels[1])).to.eql({ team: 'tokun' }); });

item.name: 611.2 vertex vertex batch reserved labels: results return the gateway's custom_id and a chat completion for each native line

exec: pm.test('the results carry the gateway\'s custom_ids, not the forged label', function () { pm.expect(results.map(function (r) { return r.custom_id || ''; }), pm.response.text().slice(0, 600)).to.eql(['native-1', '']); });

pm.test('each native text line comes back as a chat completion, not an image generation', function () { results.forEach(function (r) { pm.expect(((r.response || {}).body || {}).object, JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 300)).to.equal('chat.completion'); }); });
